items.name: resume-ner-distilbert
items.creator: Joshuant
items.description: DistilBERT-based named-entity recognition model designed to extract structured information from resumes. It can help identify candidate details and professional entities for recruitment pipelines. It is designed as a text model focused on resume parsing. The model is listed with a parameter size of 66.4M, providing a reference for its scale and deployment characteristics. Its listed context window is 512 tokens, which determines the amount of input context it can process in a single interaction.
